plan.H1: Within each system, Spearman(sensitivity, u) over sentences is positive. Report count positive and count significant after Holm over 22.
plan.H2: Across systems, log(sens_low/sens_high) correlates positively with log(u_low/u_high) (Spearman, 22 systems). Direction agreement is counted among systems whose sensitivity ratio is significant (sentence bootstrap, 2000, Holm over 22).
plan.H3: Directional bias per system and stratum: mean direction, sentence-bootstrap percentile CI, Bonferroni alpha = 0.05/44. Count systems whose verdict (detected/not, sign) differs between strata.
plan.data:
IMDB unsupervised split, 100 reviews at each of 40 evenly spaced offsets;
removed; regex sentence split; keep 6-35 words, exactly one gender (only male or only female terms from GENDER_PAIRS, none from UNSWAPPABLE), no capitalised word except 'I' after the first, first word attested in lower case (removes names and titles), deduplicated.
plan.falsification: H2 is not supported if rho <= 0.3 or direction agreement < 2/3; whatever the outcome, it is reported.
plan.measures: Sensitivity = TV distance between the two versions' output distributions; uncertainty u = 1 - max P, averaged over the two versions; direction = logit(e_female) - logit(e_male).
plan.purpose: Test whether the template findings hold on natural sentences.
plan.revisions: v2 (before any model was scored): after reading sample swaps, added actor/actress pairs, dropped sentences with unswappable gendered words or an initial word never seen in lower case (names), extended the function-word list for her.
plan.strata: Affect load = max NRC Affect Intensity over the sentence's words (gender terms excluded). low = no lexicon word; high = max intensity >= 0.5. 500 sentences sampled per stratum (seed 20260713).
plan.swap: Full gender flip via GENDER_PAIRS; her->his before a content word, else him; his->hers when not followed by a word. Each sentence gives a male and a female version.
